items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: It was Rachmaninoff. ... Gave you a choice. Rachmaninoff and Ravel.

ctx.x: He feels that music is the answer to every kind of disturbance. It would level off the world, emotional disturbances of every kind. And he studied. He's done research on some of the times that music has helped in hospitals, with physical therapy and with emotional and mental therapy.

Yeah. I was getting ready to bring that up. When I had surgery, chest surgery, some years back, after they brought me down from the operating room and to go -- there was just two patients in a room -- they would bring music in. Not pain killers. And with me it worked. I would just doze off to sleep, and soon I slept myself back to health. But it was experimental at that point. I'm going back to 1951, '52. But it worked very well. And music was the -- I'll never forget what I asked for. It was Rachmaninoff.
And they asked you what you would like to hear?
